title: ORNL Fusion Energy Week 2026
content:
ORNL Fusion Energy Week 2026 simoneausm@ornl.gov Tue, 03/24/2026 - 17:27

Fusion Energy Week at Oak Ridge National Laboratory runs Monday, May 4, through Sunday, May 10, featuring a slate of events both online and in-person to celebrate the lab's fusion research and the future of energy.

ORNL and Type One Energy are also partnering on a number of community outreach and social events in the Knoxville and Oak Ridge area to help educate the public and share the excitement around fusion energy.

Fusion Energy Week honors the May 10th birthday of Dr. Cecilia Payne-Gaposchkin, who discovered that our sun and stars were composed of hydrogen and helium, which led to our understanding of fusion. Find the schedule of events below and visit the U.S. Fusion Energy website to learn more about Fusion Energy Week activities around the world.

Schedule of Events for Fusion Energy Week 2026

Monday, May 4

  • 1 p.m. – Fusion @ ORNL: An Overview of ORNL's Fusion Energy Research Program 
    • Chuck Greenfield, ITER R&D Lead in the Fusion Energy Division, will talk about the lab's cross-directorate fusion energy program and how the lab is tackling some of fusion's biggest scientific and technical challenges. This talk will be in-person for ORNL staff in Weinberg Auditorium, Bldg. 4500N and publicly accessible via Zoom. (Watch the talk here)
  • 4 p.m. – Camp Curiosity at Burlington Branch Library
    • Join ORNL, Type One Energy and US ITER for a special fusion-themed May the Fourth activity! Kids can learn how lightsabers are connected to fusion energy and build a miniature electric motor that uses the same scientific principles as big fusion devices like ITER.
      • Burlington Branch Library – 4614 Asheville Hwy, Knoxville, TN 37914

Tuesday, May 5

  • 1 p.m. – Early Career Fusion Lightning Talks
    •  Early career researchers will share their latest work in fusion energy, offering an accessible, engaging look into different areas of fusion research. The brief talks will be followed by a Q&A session. This talk will be in-person for ORNL staff in Weinberg Auditorium, Bldg. 4500, and publicly accessible via Zoom. (Watch the talk here)

Wednesday, May 6

  • 11 a.m. - 2 p.m. – Ask a Fusion Scientist (ORNL only)
    • Fusion scientists and engineers will be set up on Main Street, Bldg. 5700, to answer your burning questions about fusion! There will also be interactive demos, models, and more to illustrate different concepts of fusion energy and the breadth of fusion research at ORNL.
  • 6 p.m. – Fusion Trivia Night at AMSE (Open to the public)
    • Join ORNL and Type One for a fun, pub-style fusion trivia night at the American Museum of Science and Energy! Test your knowledge of fusion energy, science, and more, with fun fusion-themed prizes up for grabs. All ages welcome, doors open at 6 p.m.
      • American Museum of Science and Energy – 115 E Main St, Oak Ridge, TN 37830

Thursday, May 7

  • 2 p.m. – DRGA Lab Tour (ORNL staff only, see ORNL Today for registration information)
  • 6 p.m. – Science on Tap at Xül Beer Company (Open to the public)
    • Join ORNL and Type One for an evening of networking and fusion news! Fusion experts will give brief lightning talks for a general audience in a relaxed social setting. Doors at 5 p.m., talks begin at 6 p.m.
      • Xül Beer Company – 1
